title: Moroccan Christmas
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this holiday episode, the office celebrates a Moroccan-themed Christmas party, leading to humorous conflicts over decorations and relationships. Meanwhile, Michael confronts Meredith about her drinking, revealing her admission of an addiction, and tensions rise as Angela's affair with Dwight is discovered. The episode ends with unresolved conflicts and humorous exchanges among the staff.

main_threads.thread: Office holiday celebration and conflicts over Moroccan theme

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: This is the first Christmas party I am throwing as head of the party planning committee. The theme is "Nights in Morocco".
Angela: It's the nativity scene.
Phyllis: Alright. You can keep your camel, sheep, elephant and the north African king can stay.

main_threads.thread: Michael confronts Meredith about her drinking and addiction

evidence.snippet: Michael: I want you to say I'm an alcoholic.
Meredith: I am not an alcoholic!
Meredith: I don't mind telling you that I have an addiction. I do. To porn.
Michael: Everyone in this room loves you, but mark my words, we are not going to support your alcoholism anymore.

main_threads.thread: Angela and Dwight's secret relationship and its discovery

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Okay. Angela's having sex with Dwight.
Dwight: Well don't look so surprised.
Pam: I knew it.
Jim: You did not know it.
